Grocery Stores Near Pelican Beach Resort — Destin FL 2026

Every supermarket, specialty market, and seafood shop within easy reach — with honest notes on what each one is actually good for.

By Ozan CILI, owner · Destin Condo Getaways · Updated March 2026

One of the first things guests ask after booking is “where do I stock up on groceries?” I manage two units at Pelican Beach Resort and I give guests this same rundown every time. Here it is in full — every option worth knowing, with honest notes on what each store is actually good for and what’s closest to the resort.

Short version: you have solid options in every direction. Two Publixes, Whole Foods, Walmart, Target, The Fresh Market — and a few hidden gems most guests never discover.

Interactive Map

Every store below mapped relative to Pelican Beach Resort. Tap any pin for address, hours, and what it’s best for.

Closest Grocery Options to Pelican Beach Resort

Winn-Dixie — 0.5 miles, 3 min

981 US-98 E · Mon–Sun 7am–10pm

The closest full supermarket to the resort by distance. Solid selection, good deli counter, hot bar that’s popular with guests grabbing a quick dinner. Beach accessories stocked too. The wine and beer section is well reviewed.

Heads up — this location is converting to Aldi in April/May 2026. Verify it’s still open before your trip if you’re arriving after May 2026.

Destin Euro Market — 1 mile, 5 min

743 Harbor Blvd, Ste 6 · Mon–Sat 10am–7pm

A genuine local gem that most tourists never discover. Eastern European imports — Bulgarian and Polish cheeses, smoked meats, specialty chocolates, sausages, imported breads. If you’re from Eastern Europe you’ll feel right at home. If you’re not, it’s worth a visit just for the selection of things you can’t find at Publix. The owners are warm and the prices on imported goods are fair.

Destin Ice Seafood Market & Deli — 1.3 miles, 5 min

663 Harbor Blvd · Call ahead for hours

If you’re staying in a unit with a full kitchen and want to cook fresh Gulf seafood — this is your stop. Local catch, properly handled. Our units at Pelican Beach have full kitchens for exactly this. A grouper dinner you cooked yourself, on the balcony, watching the Gulf — hard to beat.

Full Supermarkets — 4 to 10 Minutes Away

Whole Foods Market — 3.7 miles, 10 min

4402 Legendary Dr · Daily 7am–10pm

The closest large grocery store to Pelican Beach and the one many guests gravitate toward first. Organic produce, excellent prepared foods counter, a solid wine and cheese selection. Good for stocking a full kitchen for a week. Prime members get discounts. The prepared foods are especially useful on arrival day when you don’t want to cook after traveling.

Publix — Main Street, 1 mile, 5 min

771 Harbor Blvd · Daily 7am–10pm

Publix is a Florida institution and this location is the closest full-service option in the west direction. The deli is excellent — the famous Pub-Sub is a real thing and a real meal. BOGO deals rotate weekly and are worth checking. Friendly staff, clean, well-stocked. If you’re doing a full weekly shop on arrival day, this or the Commons location are your two best bets.

Publix — Destin Commons, 3.1 miles, 8 min

4425 Commons Dr E · Daily 7am–10pm

The second Publix location, right at Destin Commons near Target and The Fresh Market. Slightly larger than the Miramar Beach location. Same great deli and rotating BOGO deals. If you’re headed to Destin Commons for anything else, this is a natural stop.

Walmart Supercenter — 1.8 miles, 8 min

US-98 E · Open 24 hours

The practical choice for families. Open 24 hours, full grocery section, beach gear, sunscreen, floaties, chairs, coolers — everything for the week under one roof. Not glamorous but gets the job done at the best prices. Good option for a big arrival-day haul when you need everything at once.

Target — 0.8 miles, 4 min

Destin Commons · Daily 8am–10pm

Target’s grocery section covers the essentials plus good snack and beverage options. The real value here is the combination — grab groceries and pick up anything else you need for the vacation in the same trip. Destin Commons is an open-air shopping center so it’s a pleasant stop.

The Fresh Market — 2.4 miles, 8 min

4495 Commons Dr W · Daily 7am–9pm

The specialty choice for food-focused travelers. Excellent butcher counter with premium cuts, artisan cheeses, specialty wines, prepared foods. If you’re planning to cook a proper dinner at the condo, this is where you source the ingredients. Smaller than a full supermarket but higher quality across the board on meats, produce, and specialty items.

Grocery Delivery to Pelican Beach Resort

All major chains deliver to the resort via Instacart — Publix, Whole Foods, Walmart, Target. For guests who want to arrive to a stocked fridge, ordering the night before departure and scheduling delivery for the morning after check-in is the smoothest approach. The resort front desk can hold deliveries if needed.

For a premium option, BeMyShopper is a local Destin grocery concierge service — they do the shopping for you and deliver. Worth knowing if you want full kitchen stocking without leaving the beach on day one.

Arrival Day Tip

If you’re arriving Saturday (peak check-in day), grocery stores on US-98 get genuinely busy in the afternoon as everyone stocks up at the same time. Either go early in the morning before you head to the beach, or order via Instacart the night before arrival and schedule delivery to the resort for that morning.

The Publix Miramar Beach location tends to be slightly less crowded than the Commons location on busy check-in days.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is there a grocery store walking distance from Pelican Beach Resort?

The Destin Euro Market at 743 Harbor Blvd is about 1 mile and 5 minutes from the resort — specialty European imports, great for cheese, charcuterie, and unique finds. The Winn-Dixie at 981 US-98 is the closest full supermarket at just 0.5 miles and 3 minutes by car.

What is the closest Publix to Pelican Beach Resort Destin?

The Publix at Main Street (771 Harbor Blvd) is the closest, about 1 mile from the resort and 5 minutes by car. A second Publix is located at Destin Commons, about 3.1 miles east, 8 minutes. Both are open daily 7am–10pm.

Does Instacart deliver to Pelican Beach Resort?

Yes. Publix, Whole Foods, Walmart, and Target all deliver to Pelican Beach Resort via Instacart. Schedule delivery the morning after your arrival for the smoothest experience — the front desk can hold orders if you’re not checked in yet.

Where can I buy fresh seafood near Destin condos?

Destin Ice Seafood Market & Deli is the best local option at 663 Harbor Blvd, about 1.3 miles and 5 minutes from Pelican Beach Resort.
